_comment: Column mapping for the Transport Stack Hackathon 2026 ticket file October-Delhi.csv (ONDC e-ticketing, 1-31 Oct 2026). Source: https://pub-091bd9e794bb4877b10b29e6df80f065.r2.dev/2026-10/README.md. The data itself is not committed; download it into data/raw/2026-10/. The route column carries direction as an UP/DOWN suffix (e.g. 8UP); it is kept whole here because how UP/DOWN maps to GTFS direction_id is not known until the static GTFS is available.
